text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Fuji Kiseki was, I 
decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I made you worry. Thanks for 
looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, if you insist, I think I'll 
take a little rest.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Am I on stage...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Besides, what's with this outfit...
*sniff*... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Is someone crying...?)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(No, this is a stage... There's an 
audience, and since there's a spotlight 
too, that means—)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Isn't that my lovely little pony 
crying over there?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, that voice is...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. I've come to 
wipe away your tears!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, I'll sign autographs for 
everyone, so please line up without 
pushing...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it was a dream, huh. Well, 
somehow, I kind of figured.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, I suppose it's a good thing I 
noticed right away while on stage and was 
able to ad-lib my way through it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looks like I'm getting my usual 
groove back♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? Why are you crying in a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Senpai, that's the wrong line...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? Then... wait, what? No way, umm—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Just a dream, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A nightmare where I can't remember my 
lines at all... I used to have those a lot 
when I was little, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even now, with the turf transformed into a 
stage, some things never change, huh... 
*sigh* Doesn't feel like I got any rest at 
all...
